examples.vi: Âm nhạc tuyệt vời có thể vượt qua mọi ranh giới văn hóa.

thesaurus.definition: be greater in scope or size than some standard
be superior or better than some standard

vi_block: Vượt quá, hơn.

examples: We cannot transcend what we refuse to face.
wiktionary.gloss: To pass beyond the limits of something.
To surpass, as in intensity or power; to excel.

tatoeba.en: Music is a powerful form of communication that transcends barriers.
tatoeba.vi: Âm nhạc là một dạng thức truyền thông vượt lên trên mọi rào cản.

blocks.etymology: From unchallengeable + -ly.
vi_block: Xem unchallengeable

wiktionary.gloss: In an unchallengeable manner.

vi_block: Đơn hoạch.

wiktionary.gloss: Composed entirely of a single continuous path or line.
On one path of a moving element.
An object or figure composed entirely of a single continuous path or line, e.g. a turf maze.

blocks.etymology: It has been suggested to derive from the meaning of the phrase "up the yin-yang", where "yin-yang", a reference to a circular Taoist symbol, is used euphemistically for the human anus; the suggestion, therefore, is that one has so much of some thing that some of that thing is to be found in one's colon, or otherwise beyond one's anus. The meaning of "up the yin-yang", then, is actually "to an excessive degree".

examples: We've got bananas up the yin-yang this week. Does anyone know how to make banana bread?
wiktionary.gloss: Synonym of out the wazoo.

blocks.etymology: From Matthew 7:15 in the Bible (King James Version; spelling modernized): “Beware of false prophets which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.”
